newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Sept inflation rises 0.6 pct yr-on-yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Sept inflation rises 0.6 pct yr-on-yr.

text.p: Swiss consumer prices rose 0.1 percent in September from the previous month for a year-on-year inflation rate of 0.6 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Monthly CPI index change +0.1 pct +0.3 pct +0.1 pct

The Statistics Office said that the slight increase in September from August was due to an increase in prices of rental costs and energy, which rose 0.2 percent, transportation and communication, which rose 0.2 percent, and entertainment, relaxation, education and culture, which rose 0.1 percent.
Within these catagories, higher prices for heating oil and educational services stood out, it said.
Declines were cited for prices of home furnishings which fell 0.1 percent, and for foodstuffs, beverages and tobacco goods, which were down 0.1 percent.
Prices of domestic goods were stable while prices of imported goods rose 0.2 percent.
